purpose: Teach: オペレーティングシステム/電機/アスキー/スペル/エフェクト/パワーアップ/ポチッ/メッセンジャー
target_vocab: オペレーティングシステム

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社内端末のオペレーティングシステムを最新版にしろ
lines.en: Update the company's internal terminals to the latest operating system.
lines.style: Clipped, commanding tone. Crisp attack on the opening. No room for negotiation. Measured pace — each instruction lands with weight. Eyes forward, authority settled in the posture.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。電機メーカーとの取引契約を更新します
lines.en: Yes. I'll update the contract with the electronics manufacturer.
lines.style: Steady, professional confirmation. Slight nod in the voice. Businesslike pace. Not enthusiastic, but reliable — the tone of someone taking careful note and moving forward without fanfare.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、文字コード、つまりアスキー基準を社員に再周知しろ
lines.en: Make sure all staff are reminded about our character encoding standards — specifically ASCII compliance.
lines.style: Measured directional tone. Light emphasis on 「character encoding」— the technical term that matters. Methodical pacing. Authority without harshness. Expects competence.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。広告コピーのスペル誤りを徹底チェックします
lines.en: Understood. I'll conduct a thorough review of spelling in all advertising copy.
lines.style: Focused confirmation. Slight quickening on 「thorough review」— showing he's captured the precision required. Professional, attentive. The tone of someone translating direction into action.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新商品の効果、つまりエフェクトを動画で見せろ
lines.en: Have the new product's effects demonstrated in video format for the team.
lines.style: Directive, clear. Slight weight on 「effects」— the outcome matters. Steady, unhurried pace. The tone of someone accustomed to being listened to. No inflection wasted.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員研修のパワーアップを企画します
lines.en: Understood. I'll plan a staff training session focusing on implementation.
lines.style: Calm acknowledgment. Slight lift on 「staff training」— showing he's absorbed the scope. Measured pace, no hesitation. Professional competence settling into the next task.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、ボタンを「ポチッと押すだけ」のシンプル設計にしろ
lines.en: Keep button design simple — the kind you can press with one easy touch.
lines.style: Concrete, almost conversational within formality. Slight warmth on the analogy — 「one easy touch」brings it down to user experience. Steady, clear. Authority that explains itself.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内メッセンジャーの利用ルールを整えます
lines.en: Understood. I'll establish clear usage guidelines for the internal messaging system.
lines.style: Final confirmation. Calm, closing tone. Slight settling quality — the last nod of agreement. Professional, complete. The sound of taking the final note and moving to execute.
